summary: Moved the mobile card's expand chevron row to the bottom of the card (after .card-body, still the last child of .card and inside the row-click guard), flipped .mobileExpandRow from margin-bottom/border-bottom to margin-top/border-top with a corrected comment, and updated the .mobileExpandRow row in docs/expand-collapse.md to describe bottom-of-card placement above the detail panel. Added src/UI/MobileChevronPlacement.test.tsx covering R1-R5 (DOM order, single/many rows, no-content rows, click/keyboard behaviour, CSS separator contract, panel-below-card behaviour, desktop first-column placement and resize, docs wording).

tests.name: R1: renders the chevron row after every data row, as the last child of the card
R1: a card with a single data row still shows the chevron row below that row
R1: a card with many tall data rows keeps the chevron row after the last row
R1: a row without expandable content shows no chevron row
R1: tapping the chevron opens the detail panel for its own card only
R1: the chevron stays inside the card and its click does not trigger the row click
R1: Enter and Space toggle the chevron and aria-expanded follows the panel
R2: no bottom border or bottom margin separates the chevron row from the card body
R2: the chevron row is separated from the data above it by a top border and top margin
R2: the chevron row keeps left alignment and its flex layout
R3: a collapsed card shows no panel and an expanded card shows its panel below the card
R3: the chevron row sits between the card data and the panel it opens
R3: with two cards expanded each chevron sits above its own panel
R3: collapsing from the panel chrome closes the same panel
R5: the expand-collapse docs describe the chevron row at the bottom of the card
R4: the chevron stays in the first column of the table row and no mobile chevron row renders
R4: resizing mobile to desktop and back switches between bottom-of-card and first-column placement
